metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for resolving active OpenTelemetry spans in distributed tracing context. It has unique semantic identity (span retrieval and validation from context, parent trace matching) that does not overlap with existing skills. Peer candidates address complementary concerns (span hierarchy composition, attribute extraction, span management) but operate at different workflow stages and with different objectives. No existing skill covers the specific capability of retrieving, validating, and resolving the current span to session/root trace context.
